File surface: on `origin/main` `ceb4a939b4`. `packages/spec`: one shared predicate (beside `src/data/analytics-column-reference.ts`) and the three cross-field refinements it backs. They are `MetricSchema`'s `sql` under a non-`count` aggregate and `DimensionSchema`'s `sql` (`src/data/analytics.zod.ts`), and `DatasetMeasureSchema`'s `field` under a non-`count` aggregate (`src/ui/dataset.zod.ts`), with their tests. Also the `dropped-refinements.baseline.json` gap entries the gate requires, the `liveness/analytics_cube.json` note re-pointed here (and `liveness/dataset.json` if it names the boundary), one ADR-0087 semantic entry with its generated `migrations/registry.ts` region, the regenerated reference pages, and one `@objectstack/spec` changeset. Declared cross-lane test-only surface: one door cell pinning the measured 500 → 400 (`service-analytics` or `rest` tests). ⛔ No strategy code edit. Stop on breach; explain in the report.
Container & model: `M`, `mode:subagent`, `model: opus` (default build tier; `packages/spec/src/**` non-test, so the contract review runs at `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` through an isolated subagent)
Clause-②: no (narrowing) per triage's card; the dev confirms the arm with `check-widening-tells` and switches to yes (narrowing) only if an export-listing row is added
Thread-read: none
Serial constraints cleared: at 2026-10-02T13:55Z, PR #21413 (#20274, spec seat 2) edits `dropped-refinements.baseline.json` and `migrations/registry.ts`, and this seat's #21293 (in flight) adds a `registry.ts` entry. Each generated region merges through `scripts/pm/os-regen-merge.sh` by whichever lands later. #21000 (`pm:queue`) and #21365 (`domain:services`) also edit `analytics.zod.ts` in other regions; whichever lands later merges `main`. This seat's PR #21416 (#21082) deliberately leaves `'*'` unrefused in lint.
